user_query: I'm organizing a music trivia night with my friends, and I need some questions about R&B/Hip-Hop music. Can you provide me with the greatest of all time top R&B/Hip-Hop artists and their popular songs? Also, give me the playlist info and track details for the song 'Crazy in Love' by Beyoncé featuring Jay-Z.

TaskList.description: Fetch a list of the greatest R&B/Hip-Hop artists of all time along with their popular songs.
Retrieve detailed information about the song 'Crazy in Love' by Beyoncé featuring Jay-Z, including playlist info and track details.
Compile the information from subtasks 1 and 2 into a trivia format suitable for a music night.
